### Complete CSV summaries and outputs {#f01-csv-review}

Tables read the saved CSVs directly, preserving full numeric precision and
missing-value labels. Scroll within wide or long tables to inspect all values;
the download retains the original CSV. The RD04 audit and estimate tables
continue the modeling record through inference and display.

```{r}
#| label: f01-csv-source-review
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

source("scripts/render-csv-review.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
tasks <- jsonlite::fromJSON("tasks.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
fuel_task <- Filter(function(task) task$id == "F01", tasks)[[1]]
groups <- c(
  data = "Component definitions, pairing, and exploration",
  manifests = "Model candidates, registries, and provisional leaders",
  `inference-audit` = "RD04 inference audit",
  tables = "RD04 figure estimates"
)
for (directory in names(groups)) {
  cat("\n#### ", groups[[directory]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  prefix <- paste0("analysis/outputs/publication/fuel/", directory, "/")
  paths <- sort(unlist(fuel_task$files))
  paths <- paths[startsWith(paths, prefix) & endsWith(paths, ".csv")]
  for (path in paths) render_csv_review(path)
}
```
